info.name: Society Management API
info.description:
Works against the dynamic-roles model (V3). Run the folders top to bottom, or the whole collection in the Runner — every request has a status assertion.

1. Auth logs in as the platform SUPER_ADMIN (Stan Lee) — everything in folders 2–6 runs with {{superAdminToken}}.
2–5 build a fresh society → wing → flat and create a SECRETARY, GUARD and RESIDENT in it (random phones, password Pass@123), saving every id.
6 logs in as those users; 7 runs the visitor gate flow; 8–9 exercise role assignment and role definitions; 10 checks what each role must NOT be able to do; 14 runs maintenance billing and payments in the new society.

Existing local data: Nick Fury (9000000616) is SECRETARY of Avengers Tower. Every local user's password is Pass@123.

7. Visitors
item.description: Gate flow for the flat created in folder 4: the guard logs visitors, the flat's resident approves or rejects (first answer wins); a SECRETARY or above may decide on the flat's behalf, recorded as an override; the guard marks entered/exited. Residents see only their own flat; guards and committee see the whole society. Push notifications are only logged server-side until FCM is wired up. Must run before folder 8, which deactivates (and then reactivates) the guard.

item.name: 14. Maintenance
item.description: Billing settings and late fees, charge heads, a billing cycle (next period → preview → issue), bills, a part payment and its receipt, dues and reminders, CSV exports, void / waive / cancel, and opening balances. Runs in the society from folders 2–6 as its SECRETARY and RESIDENT. Bills are kept as history, so after this folder the flat, wing and society can no longer be deleted (cleanup gets 409 for them).
